scoring_justification: The adaptive loop plus model training is too heavy for the verifier; hidden thresholds are derived from the paper's reported values with tolerances to account for stochasticity.

hidden_assets.purpose: Thresholds for average relative error, maximum relative error, and expected training set size range
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 3 and text: average benchmark error <1%, max <10%, final training set size 24 points
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from paper-reported quantities with added slack to accommodate run-to-run variation
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly traceable to the paper's 1D showcase results; tolerances are set wide enough for a correct re-implementation but not so wide that they accept random guesses.

outputs.description: Contains the average relative error, maximum relative error on a 1000-point random benchmark, and the size of the final training set produced by the adaptive procedure.

output_contract.notes: The tolerance thresholds for the errors and the acceptable range for the training set size are hidden; the policy threshold_or_better means that meeting or beating the reference performance earns full credit.
